brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:84fceafa-3528-48ff-8.title: Head of People
brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:84fceafa-3528-48ff-8.description: ABOUT BRINC: At BRINC, we are redefining public safety with an innovative ecosystem of life-saving tools. Our journey started with the development of drones and ruggedized throw phones, designed to access unsafe areas and establish communication to de-escalate situations. Today, we've expanded into creating and deploying 911 response networks, where drones are dispatched to 911 calls to provide real-time visual data, enhancing safety and enabling de-escalation-focused responses. Our cutting-edge solutions are utilized by over 600 public safety agencies across America and the company has raised over $150M from investors, including Index Ventures, Motorola Solutions, Sam Altman, Dylan Field, Mike Volpe, Alexandr Wang and more. At BRINC, we are committed to recruiting the world's best talent to join us in our mission to support first responders in saving lives. About this Role: The Head of People will be responsible for driving BRINC’s overall human resources & talent acquisition strategy and ensuring alignment with the company’s goals and culture. This role involves leadership of the People team, overseeing talent acquisition, employee development, performance management, compensation and benefits, payroll, workplace experiences, and employee relations. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in people operations, team development, and organizational design, with the ability to create a high-performance culture while fostering an inclusive and supportive work environment. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Lead the People function, including talent acquisition, performance management, employee engagement, and organizational development. - Develop and implement strategies for attracting, retaining, and developing top talent in alignment with the company’s long-term goals. - Partner with senior leadership to shape the company’s culture, ensuring alignment with organizational values, mission, and vision. - Oversee the implementation of effective talent management strategies, including succession planning, and in the future leadership development and career pathing. - Drive performance management processes, including goal setting, feedback, and employee development plans, to ensure a high-performance culture. - Create competitive compensation and benefits programs that align with industry standards and company objectives. - Provide strategic guidance and support for employee relations, resolving conflicts, and fostering an inclusive, collaborative environment. - Develop and manage employee engagement initiatives, including surveys, feedback loops, and programs aimed at improving employee satisfaction and retention. - Monitor and analyze people data to identify trends, address potential challenges, and make data-driven recommendations to improve people practices. - Create and design delivery of training and development programs to support employee growth, leadership, and skills development. - Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Finance, Engineering, Revenue, and Operations, to ensure the alignment of People initiatives with company priorities and legal compliance. - Build and maintain strong relationships with employees across all levels of the organization, ensuring open communication channels and a strong sense of trust. - Lead change management initiatives to support the company’s growth, scalability, and evolving needs. - Stay up-to-date with HR best practices, industry trends, and regulatory changes to ensure the organization remains competitive and compliant. QUALIFICATIONS: - Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field or equivalent years of experience in lieu of an education. - 8+ years of experience in talent acquisition, with at least 4 years in a leadership role owning a recruiting function at a high-growth company. - Experience working in a high-growth or startup environment. - Proven experience in people management, talent acquisition, organizational development, and perf

jobgether-jobgether:lever:020ca0ea-351f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Developer (Flutter) based in France. This is a high-impact opportunity to own the mobile experience of a digital retail ecosystem used in demanding, real-world store environments. You’ll build a high-performance mobile application connecting directly with payment terminals, printers, barcode scanners, and other specialized hardware. The role goes beyond conventional app development, combining Flutter with native Android/iOS capabilities through an Add-to-App architecture. You’ll help deliver critical features spanning point-of-sale, billing, inventory, banking, B2B commerce, and AI-powered user assistance. A strong focus on offline-first architecture, reliability, speed, and seamless checkout experiences makes this a technically challenging role. You’ll work closely with Product and Backend teams in a fully remote, international environment where autonomy and ownership are highly valued. It’s an excellent fit for an experienced Flutter developer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building products with tangible everyday impact. Own and develop the mobile experience for a mission-critical digital retail platform used in fast-paced store environments. Build and maintain Flutter modules using an Add-to-App architecture, enabling seamless communication between Dart and native Android/iOS SDKs. Develop native integrations with payment terminals, receipt printers, barcode scanners, and other retail hardware. Develop and maintain features across point-of-sale sales and billing, B2B marketplace, banking, inventory management, and AI-powered assistance. Create high-quality, pixel-accurate interfaces from Figma designs, optimized for rapid interaction and busy retail environments. Design and implement robust offline-first capabilities using local storage technologies such as SQLite. Optimize application performance to deliver fast, responsive, reliable, and crash-resistant experiences. Develop and maintain integration tests, particularly for hardware-sensitive and transaction-critical workflows. Establish mobile development best practices, participate in code reviews, and maintain high standards across the codebase. Collaborate closely with Product Management and Backend Engineering to define requirements, plan delivery, and resolve technical challenges. Take ownership of assigned initiatives from planning through implementation and delivery, ensuring high-quality results and dependable timelines. Requirements: 5+ years of professional mobile development experience, including at least 3 years of deep, hands-on Flutter development. Strong expertise in Flutter and Dart, with proven experience using Flutter's Add-to-App architecture. Professional experience with native mobile development, particularly Kotlin/Android or Swift/iOS. Experience integrating mobile applications with external hardware and native SDKs, ideally payment terminals, receipt printers, or barcode scanners. Strong understanding of mobile state management, REST API integration, and local database technologies such as SQLite. Strong understanding of mobile performance optimization, application reliability, and production-quality development practices. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines. jobgether-jobgether:lever:0b88601d-7319-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You will help expand market opportunities while supporting the adoption of digital-ready and SF6-free technologies. Your technical leadership will influence product configuration, solution design, standards alignment, and customer requirements. Support industry representation: Represent the organization at relevant customer meetings, conferences, and industry events, helping strengthen its position within the sub-transmission market. Familiarity with IEEE and ANSI standards applicable to high-voltage electrical products. Ability to combine technical depth with commercial awareness and identify opportunities for product and market growth. jobgether-jobgether:lever:85f22fb0-a860-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Consultant, Organizational Design based in United States. This role offers the opportunity to lead a high-impact organizational design and research initiative for a complex, large-scale enterprise environment. You will conduct hands-on research, engage stakeholders, and gather insights across multiple organizational levels and locations. Your work will help identify organizational opportunities, employee experience improvements, and areas for greater effectiveness. You will translate qualitative and quantitative findings into practical recommendations, business impact analyses, and implementation roadmaps. The position combines strategic consulting with direct field engagement, executive communication, and analytical problem-solving. After an initial onboarding period, the role includes travel to dispersed U.S. client locations followed by a remote phase focused on recommendations and executive readouts. This is a six-month consulting engagement with potential for extension and significant exposure to senior leadership and organizational transformation initiatives. Design and execute comprehensive internal and external research studies to support organizational design, effectiveness, and optimization strategies. Develop and apply research methodologies including focus groups, stakeholder interviews, surveys, benchmarking, market research, and other qualitative and quantitative approaches. Conduct hands-on research and facilitate discussions with stakeholders across different organizational levels, functions, and local markets. Travel to dispersed U.S. client locations to collect employee feedback, conduct focus groups, and gather insights during the research phase. Analyze and synthesize research findings to identify organizational trends, gaps, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Develop ROI and business impact analyses to assess the potential value and implications of organizational changes. Translate complex research findings into clear, actionable organizational design and organizational development recommendations. Develop strategic roadmaps connecting research insights and recommendations to practical implementation plans. Create polished, executive-ready presentations, reports, analyses, and supporting documentation. Present findings, recommendations, and executive readouts to stakeholders at all levels, including senior and executive leadership. Partner with client stakeholders to ensure research findings and recommendations are aligned with broader business objectives and organizational strategy. Support the transition from organizational strategy and design into potential implementation activities during subsequent phases of the engagement. Independently manage multiple workstreams while maintaining high standards for quality, communication, and delivery. Requirements Demonstrated experience supporting large, complex organizations, preferably Fortune 100 enterprises, through organizational research, organizational design, organizational effectiveness, strategy, transformation, or related consulting engagements. Hands-on experience designing and conducting internal and external research studies. Strong experience facilitating focus groups, stakeholder interviews, organizational assessments, benchmarking exercises, and research-driven strategy initiatives. Proven ability to take consulting engagements from research and analysis through recommendations, strategic roadmaps, and implementation planning. Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex qualitative and quantitative findings into practical business recommendations. Strong analytical capabilities, including experience evaluating research findings and developing ROI or business impact analyses.
